scope: Replacement frame candidates; frozen per-scan frame-only alignment before color-insensitive edge scoring at 1 px. No rejected fit is scored. Baseline imported symbols vs reviewed-source policy plus shared family geometry. These development examples are not a corpus accuracy claim.

candidatePolicy.method: Render candidate cost/symbol layers on a fixed blank frame, score against the frozen normalized scan; exhaustive family grid, color-insensitive edge F1 at 1 px. All cards are development examples, no unseen-set accuracy claim.
